$comment: Machine-readable instructions for adding or changing materials and resources in Airtable · PEA Resource List. For Claude or any assistant working for the PEA team. Mirrors the rules enforced by maintenance/scripts/sync-resources.js (build) and check-parity.js (checkItem); check-parity.js keeps this file consistent with facts.js and the sync script's field IDs. Human guide: maintenance/runbooks/adding-resources.md. No personal data belongs in this file (the repo is public).

resources.name: Resources
resources.one_row_per: link (one resource or material; ES and EN versions of the same thing share a row)

groups.name: Groups
groups.one_row_per: curated sub-group on one class card

meta.authority: Airtable is the source of every material and resource on the site (Danny Hernández, 2026-11-14). The site reads only Published rows, through the generated site/assets/js/resources.js.

fields.notes: Only Published reaches the site. New rows start as To review. Archived = retired, kept for history.

fields.required_when: outside resource with Link (ES) or Link (both pages)
fields.notes: Spanish row text. Pattern: 'Título (Organización)'. Add ' (sitio en inglés)' when the only link is an English page shown on the Spanish page. Optional on ALL In Education materials on a class (the Material type gives the title), but required when the material is in Featured in.

fields.required_when: outside resource (always recommended; needed with Link (EN) or Link (both pages))
fields.notes: English row text. Pattern: 'Title (Organization)'. Never translate ALL In Education.
Spanish version. Leave empty when Link (both pages) is used.
English version. Leave empty when Link (both pages) is used. Required on a Presentation.
One URL shown on both pages (a site with a language switch, or a single bilingual file). Never together with Link (ES)/(EN).
Languages the destination really serves (review Q5). Leave empty only if not recorded.

fields.required_when: the row has no Classes, Groups or Featured in (it then shows only on Materiales y recursos)
fields.notes: Otherwise set it only when the row's subject differs from its class's topic.
Class cards that list the row outside any group. Required for ALL In Education materials.
Curated groups the row appears in. In-group order = order of the group's Resources list (drag in Airtable).
Shows the row under ⭐ Destacado / Featured on these class cards.

fields.allowed_when: Material type = Presentation (required there), or the row uses Featured in
fields.notes: Limits the row to one cohort's classes. Empty = every cohort.
Position outside groups, lower first. Use steps of 10 (10, 20, 30) to leave room.
Staff reference only; not shown on the site (the organization goes in the title).
Review Q3: for time-sensitive content (deadlines, dates, figures).
Staff notes: source, who asked for it, why it was archived. Never personal data about participants.
Link the participant suggestion the row came from, if any.
Primary field, for staff: '<class code> · <English title>', e.g. '4R · Finding books'. CSV imports link groups by this name.
Only when the whole group belongs to another topic than its class. Same choices as Resources Topic.
Position among the class's rows and groups (steps of 10).
The order of this list is the order inside the group on the site.

rules.requirement: Use Link (both pages) alone, or Link (ES) and/or Link (EN). Never both shapes on one row. At least one link.
Links start with https://. Prefer the final page URL to a shortlink (bit.ly, tinyurl): shortlinks hide duplicates and can break.

rules.condition: Kind = Outside resource AND (Link (ES) OR Link (both pages))
Kind = Outside resource AND (Link (EN) OR Link (both pages))

rules.requirement: Languages served lists the languages the page really serves.
Material type is set and the row has Classes (or Featured in).

rules.condition: Kind = ALL In Education material AND Featured in
rules.requirement: Title (ES) for a Spanish or shared link and Title (EN) for an English or shared link (featured rows get no standard type title; check-parity.js rejects them).
Classes + Cohort + Link (EN). One presentation per cohort and class: the sync keeps only one, so a new file replaces the link on the existing row.
rules.enforced_by: sync-resources.js, validator (against the file and the published site)

rules.requirement: The row is a Presentation, or uses Featured in. Cohort on a plain class row stops the sync.

rules.condition: No Classes, Groups or Featured in
rules.requirement: Topic is set. Such a row shows only on Materiales y recursos.
Topic, Classes, Featured in, Cohort, Kind, Material type and Status use the exact choice names above. Never create a new choice in Airtable; a new topic or class needs a site change first.

rules.condition: Link is a Google Drive / Docs file
rules.requirement: The file is shared 'Anyone with the link · Viewer' before the row is Published.
Search the base (all statuses) and the published list for the normalized URL before adding. A link already on a class stays there; add the class to the existing row instead of a new row.
rules.enforced_by: validator (published + within file); human search for To review/Archived rows

rules.requirement: Never 'empower' or any variant (empoderar, empoderamiento). 'maestros', not 'docentes'. 'salón/clase', not 'aula'. 'ustedes', not 'vosotros'.
'Academia de Padres Educadores' in Spanish, 'Parent Educator Academy' in English, 'PEA' in both. Never translate 'ALL In Education' or 'Leadership · Power · Justice'.
Alignment A1–A4 and Quality Q1–Q6 all pass (maintenance/plans/resource-suggestions-plan-v1.0.md §2).
No participant names, emails, phones or private Zoom links in any Resources or Groups field. The repo and site are public.

normalize: drop tracking parameters: utm_*, fbclid, gclid, usp
keep every other query parameter (Drive ?id=, YouTube ?v= identify the file)
dedupe.on_match: Do not add a row. Update the existing row (add a class, group or topic) or report the match.

add_resource: Search the base (all statuses) and the site for the link (dedupe rules). Stop if it exists; extend that row instead.
Run the alignment (A1–A4) and quality (Q1–Q6) checks; record Languages served from what the page really shows.
Create a Resources row: Kind = Outside resource; Status = To review; Title (ES)/(EN) per the title rules; links in the right shape.
Place it: Classes (card, outside groups) and/or Groups (inside a curated group) and/or Featured in; or no placement + Topic (Materiales y recursos only).
Set Topic when the subject differs from the class topic; set Order in steps of 10 for rows outside groups.
If placed in a group, drag it to its position in the group's Resources list.
When the checks pass, set Status = Published, then run the publish procedure.
add_material: Confirm the Drive file is shared 'Anyone with the link · Viewer'.
Create a Resources row: Kind = ALL In Education material; Material type; Classes = the class; Link (ES) and/or Link (EN). Titles only when the standard type title is not right.
Presentation: also Cohort (e.g. FA26) and Link (EN) (one per cohort and class).
Order in steps of 10 (worksheet, then communication tool, then handouts is the usual order).
Status = Published when the files are final, then publish.
replace_material_version: Find the existing row (same class, same Material type).
Replace the URL in Link (ES)/(EN). Do not create a second row; the row keeps its order and history.
Write the date and reason in Notes (Internal), then publish.
add_group: Create a Groups row: Group = '<class code> · <English title>', Title (ES), Title (EN), Class, Order (steps of 10); Topic only if the whole group belongs to another topic; Keep together if needed.
Link the Resources rows to the group and drag them into order in the group's Resources list.
A group needs at least one Published row to show.
bulk_import: Copy maintenance/templates/resources-import.csv; one row per link; keep the header exactly.
Status = To review on every row.
Run: node maintenance/scripts/validate-resource-import.js <file.csv>. Fix every reported row until it prints OK.
Search the base for To review / Archived duplicates (the validator only knows Published links).
Airtable → Resources → import the CSV, appending to the existing table; map each column to the field of the same name.
Check the imported rows in a view filtered to To review; link groups (names with commas are linked by hand) and drag group order.
Run the quality checks, set Published in small batches, then publish.
retire: Set Status = Archived and write the reason and date in Notes (Internal). Never delete a row.
publish: GitHub → Actions → 'Sync resources from Airtable' → Run workflow (branch main), or wait for the daily 6:17 AM Arizona run.
If the run stops with 'SYNC STOPPED', fix each named row in Airtable and run again.
Open the pull request 'Resources: sync from Airtable', check the Netlify preview (class cards and Materiales y recursos, ES and EN), merge.

never: Edit materials or resources in site/assets/js/facts.js or by hand in site/assets/js/resources.js.
Delete Resources or Groups rows (Archive instead).
Create new select choices (topics, classes, cohorts, material types) in Airtable without a matching site change.
Put a linked-record field (alumni, resources) on a public form.
Publish a Drive file that is not shared 'Anyone with the link'.
Use bit.ly shortlinks for this site's own pages; shared links to the site open the Spanish page.
